news.why_it_matters: Escalates the political risk on the ~£330m ($441m) NHS deal from generic scrutiny to an explicit termination push by lawmakers, keeping pressure on the stock ahead of Aug 3 earnings even though the UK contract is a small slice of total revenue.

news.why_it_matters: A bullish sell-side counterweight arguing commercial revenue growth could beat management's 79% guide, useful context for holders weighing today's pullback against the upcoming print.

Riley to $66) raised targets post-earnings, pushing consensus toward ~$77-79 with a Strong Buy skew, reinforcing the bull case on hyperscaler lease demand even though the stock trades well below those targets.

news.headline: Sell-side cuts price targets after emideltide rejection (BofA to $30, TD Cowen to $25, Truist to $23)

news.headline: Multiple sell-side firms raise price targets following last week's Q2 beat
news.why_it_matters: Continued target hikes (Bernstein, BMO, Evercore, and others) reinforce the application-layer AI rotation thesis and management's raised 2026 AI ACV target, supportive of the bull case for a multi-year holder even after the recent run-up.

news.headline: No new catalysts since this morning; FY26 Q4 earnings due tomorrow (7/29) after the close
news.why_it_matters: Options are pricing a large post-earnings swing, with Azure growth (guided to the fastest pace in over a year) and the record ~$190B 2026 capex plan as the key swing factors for a long-term thesis built on AI monetization versus margin/FCF pressure.

news.headline: Shares touched a fresh intraday 52-week low (~$114.51) before paring losses to close roughly flat
news.why_it_matters: Confirms the selloff is still live intraday even though the close was little-changed - compounds concerns already known this morning (S&P BBB- downgrade, OpenAI concentration, AI-capex debt burn); watch whether the $638B backlog/OCI demand narrative can arrest the decline.

news.headline: Federal judge's dismissal of the RESPA/RICO class action (7/27) stands; no further developments today
news.why_it_matters: The legal overhang removed yesterday remains removed, confirming the positive read-through holds into the Aug 5 earnings print.

news.why_it_matters: A distinct, still-live legal risk from the case dismissed yesterday - litigation overhang isn't fully cleared even though the specific RESPA/RICO threat is gone.
